target_customer: Builders of drones, submarines and satellites in the US who need custom aerospace-grade battery packs in volume
problem: Legacy battery supply chains take 12 or more months to deliver custom packs, while 100,000+ drones, submarines and satellites are being built in the US. Kyten aims to build a factory that delivers custom packs in weeks.
business_model: Hardware manufacturing of custom battery packs sold per order to defense and aerospace customers
product_category: Aerospace and defense battery pack manufacturing

founders.name: Cooper McBride
founders.background_notes: YC page: went from a Tesla intern to leading 30+ person engineering teams at SpaceX and Shield AI over six years. Crunchbase search snippet lists him as CEO.

founders.name: Lucas Maddox
previous_startups: Unnamed earlier startup (failed, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says his previous startup failed and he returned to SpaceX as an engineering lead. The launch post says the cofounders spent a combined eight years at Starlink and Shield AI.

competitors.name: Re:Build Battery Solutions
competitors.what: US custom battery design and manufacturing unit serving aerospace and defense
competitors.traction_then: Launched its battery unit in January 2025; store for drone batteries listed

technical_complexity.rationale: Aerospace-grade packs need cell qualification, thermal and safety validation and a rapid-turn factory. A two-person team had flight heritage from Starlink (5,000+ packs claimed) but no factory yet.

defensibility.rationale: Qualification data and flight heritage take time to earn, but a large prime or Tier 1 could do this in-house.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move against Kyten was found. A directory review flagged primes building in-house as the main risk.

market_need_then: Defense and space customers faced 12 to 18 month lead times for custom packs per the company, and US drone and space production was growing quickly in 2025 and 2026. Claims are from the company's own launch post.

branding.domain_note: Uses kytentech.com (name plus tech suffix); acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found

branding.brand_signature: 5,000+ battery packs put into space at Starlink (founder credential)

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself. Search for the name returned results for Lyten, a different battery company, which suggests confusion risk. The website returned HTTP 402 when fetched.

outcome_analysis: Kyten was a two-person winter 2026 company founded by SpaceX and Shield AI alumni to build a rapid-turn aerospace battery factory. The YC directory lists it as inactive, but no shutdown, acquisition or post-mortem was found and its site was not fetchable (HTTP 402), so the cause of the inactive status is not public. Secondary profiles as late as August 2026 describe it as operating.
notes: The pre-seed round rests on a single database (VCBacked) with no amount; a $320K figure near Kyten's entry was ambiguous and is unverified. Company site fetch returned HTTP 402. YC status Inactive conflicts with secondary profiles calling it active; exit left unknown. Only one dated competitor was found; others seen in results lacked dates.
